title: Provenance
description: What the Desk records today about where a model answer came from: one row per model request, with the provider-neutral completion (finish reason and token counts) and the phase it served. Read from ExecutionCheckpoint.completions (web/src/assistant/execution/state.ts) and ModelCompletion (web/src/assistant/completion.ts, readCompletion; Go aifailure.Completion). Open: readCompletion and readExecution accept members they do not name. A request the provider refused and that was sent again has one row per attempt (packages/harness/engines/vercel/retry.ts; execution/controller.ts, recordRefusal): the refused attempt's row carries attempt, failure and waitMs, and the attempt that answered carries its attempt number. Since ADR-0005 the adapter assembles the whole prompt and records the digest of every request body it sent, in order, in the checkpoint's prompts ($defs/promptDigest). There is no model name, adapter or contract version or request timing in any record that crosses the slot (waitMs is the wait before a retry, not a timing) (see docs/design/wire-contract.md, Open questions). Delegation (agent#18): each delegated child's model, requests, tool calls, token counts, time to first byte and duration, each batch's total and the parent's own, carried by the checkpoint's delegation member ($defs/delegationReport) and each task record (delegated-task.json). Tool sources (ADR-0006): each source's calls, refusals, proposals, bytes and time, the Runtime's among them, in the checkpoint's sources ($defs/sourceFigures). The critic's switch (ADR-0010): whether the critic ran on the run, why, at which tier and on which trigger, in the checkpoint's critic and the critic_decided event ($defs/criticDecision).

request.description: Which model request of the execution this was, counted from 1; at most the checkpoint's used count.

phase.description: work: the main loop. synthesis: the one tool-free request that finishes a response cut short. review: the critic.

attempt.description: Which attempt at this request the row records, from 1, where the provider refused the request and it was sent again: at most three (two retries). Absent on a request answered at its first attempt.

failure.description: On a refused attempt's row: the refusal, classified (outcome refused). The row's result has finishReason error.

waitMs.description: On a refused attempt's row: the wait before the next attempt, in milliseconds, the longer of the backoff (1000, then 2000) and the provider's Retry-After; at most 30000 as the vercel engine waits, and readExecution accepts up to a day. Absent where no attempt followed.

connection.description: ADR-0020. The host connection that answered this request; on a switched request, the fallback connection.

role.description: ADR-0020. The policy role this request served.

recordDigest.description: sha256: and the lower-case SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the complete record with digest omitted.

retainUntil.description: The instant after which the host deletes the record and the package refuses it for resume.

completion.description: Provider-neutral completion metadata (ModelCompletion). Never raw provider text or reasoning. Open: readCompletion keeps only these members and drops any other.

finishReason.description: COMPLETION_REASONS. A reason outside the list is recorded as other.

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens the provider read from its prompt cache, where it reports them (the SDK's inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens). Recorded by this harness since agent#9; the Desk's Go reader drops it until its swap.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Input tokens the provider wrote to its prompt cache, where it reports them (inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens). Recorded by this harness since agent#9; the Desk's Go reader drops it until its swap.

tokens.description: A count the provider reported; a safe integer, never negative. Absent where the provider reported none.

sha256.description: A lower-case hex SHA-256 digest, as the Desk writes requestKey, retained-entry digests and the project brief's header.

requestKey.description: The SHA-256 of the JSON text {"request":…,"phase":…,"purpose":…} for the person's current request (ExecutionController.initialize). It binds a checkpoint to the request it was made for; it is not a digest of the prompt sent to the model.

promptDigest.description: The digest of one request body the adapter sent (ADR-0005; packages/harness/execution/controller.ts, recordPrompt; Go ExecutionController.RecordPrompt), recorded before the request is sent, in the checkpoint's prompts. On a model engine the body is the provider body the adapter handed the relay capability (model.call), each model request and each retried attempt its own; on the agent wire it is the agent request as the transport sends it to the bridge, as JSON text, without the delegation coordinator's delegated mark, one per agent run; there it reaches the host on the run's next execution_checkpoint event, on a tracked run. The relay adds nothing to the prompt, so the digest is of what the model was shown, the credential and the relay's own headers aside.

request.description: Which request body of the execution this was, counted from 1 in the order sent; one more than the last recorded, carried across a resumed execution as used is.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the body's UTF-8 text, lower-case hex.

compactionSummary.description: One ADR-0016 replacement carried through a resume. digest identifies the framed replacement; digests identify the original turns it replaced.

compactionReport.description: ADR-0016's run report row, carried in the checkpoint.

engine.description: The engine id a session ran on (Engine.id, the AssistantEngine identifier). Held by the host, never carried on an event. The Desk's two (contract/desk/inventory.json), then deepagents, the adapter this repository adds on LangChain's Deep Agents (docs/adr/0003-the-deep-agents-adapter.md), then eino, the Go adapter on Eino's ADK (docs/adr/0004-the-go-adapter.md), which the TypeScript registry does not load.

criticFigures.description: What one critic pass cost (agent#10; packages/harness/refutation.ts, CriticFigures), carried on the critique event and on a critic-unfinished note (run-event.json). model: the model the critic ran on, the host's critic model for the connection (the critic member of modelsFor, asked once per run) or the run's. unit model-requests (the vercel engine): requests counts the model requests the critic claimed against the allowance, refused attempts included, and the token members sum what its completion rows (phase review) reported, each absent where no row reported it. unit agent-runs (the codex engine): requests counts the critic's agent runs, and the bridge reports no tokens. harnessCalls counts the harness's own runtime calls in the pass.

harnessCalls.description: The runtime calls the harness made itself in the pass for declared cases the critic left uncompared (review row 8), each marked origin harness on its events; absent where it made none. Not model requests.

tokenFigures.description: Token counts the provider reported, summed over requests (agent#18): each member as completion's, absent where no request reported it.

childFigures.description: One delegated child's figures (agent#18), as its task record carries them. modelRequests: on a model capability, its requests, a retried attempt counted; absent on an agent capability (agent#71), the provider running its own loop and reporting no request count, and agentRuns its runs. The checkpoint requires it where its unit is model-requests and leaves it optional where the unit is provider-managed (checkpoint.json, delegation). firstByteMs: from its start to the first byte of its first answer (an agent's first event), absent where none came. durationMs: from its start to its end. partial and reused as the record's. Declared children carry subagent; group these figures by id and digest for per-definition totals. Built-ins carry profile alone.

batch.description: Which batch of the execution, from 1.

figuresTotal.description: A batch's total (agent#18): its children's modelRequests, toolCalls, agentRuns and tokens summed (a token member present where any child's was), and its wall time from its first child's start to its last child's end. modelRequests counts model requests only: absent on an agent capability, where no child has one (agent#71), and required where the checkpoint's unit is model-requests (checkpoint.json, delegation).

parentFigures.description: The parent's own figures beside its batches (agent#18): its model; its own model requests, the execution's used less its children's, absent on an agent capability, where the provider runs its own loop and reports no count (agent#71; required where the checkpoint's unit is model-requests, checkpoint.json, delegation); on an agent capability, its own agent runs of the response; its own token counts, from its completion rows, absent on an agent capability.

delegationReport.description: What delegation cost in one execution (agent#18), as the checkpoint's delegation member carries it: each batch with its children's figures and its total, and the parent's own. Written by the delegation coordinator on every checkpoint of the parent after its first batch, carried through a resume as used is, and read closed by the harness's readExecution (validDelegationFigures). The Desk's report lines that show it are the Desk's (desk#499).

sourceFigures.description: What one source cost in one execution (ADR-0006): the run report's row for it, in the checkpoint's sources. calls: the calls the host ran; refused: the calls the boundary refused before the host (a changed tool list, no approval, a catalogued tool not loaded, past sourceCallsPerTurn); proposed: the calls held as proposals; bytes: the UTF-8 bytes of the answers' JSON text as the host gave them, before any bound; milliseconds: the time the host took, summed over the calls it ran. The Runtime's row is source runtime, kind runtime. skills (ADR-0009): the skills of this source the model loaded, each load counted, a reload again; present on a source that declares a skill. A source that declares only skills reports its loads and no calls; exchange is a skill's kind only.

identities.description: Calls the host ran, grouped by the identity pinned on that source (ADR-0019). A changed identity is refused and does not add a call.

identityFigures.description: One identity's call count in a source's run figures (ADR-0019). Identity is reported, never a grant.

skillLoad.description: One loaded skill as the checkpoint keeps it (ADR-0009; checkpoint.json skills): its id, the digest it was loaded at, its bytes (skill.json#/$defs/bytes) and when it was loaded. A continued run restores it only where the host still declares the skill with that digest.

criticReason.description: Why the critic ran or did not (ADR-0010), one enum. The layer that set the mode: person (the run's word), project, table. The trigger under auto: cases (declared cases exist), changes-existing (the proposal changes an existing pack), model-asked (the model called request_review). Not run: no-proposal (nothing to refute), off (the mode is off), budget (the request allowance, or on the agent capability the invocations, left none for the critic). Forced off whatever the mode: reviewer-assigned, purpose (a graph-purpose run), phase (Plan mode), child (a delegated child).

criticDecision.description: The critic's decision for one run, the report's row (ADR-0010): the mode (run > project > table), whether the critic ran, the reason, the tier the critic ran or would run at, and under auto the trigger. reason: a forced-off reason (child, phase, purpose, reviewer-assigned, in that order) whatever the mode; else off under off; else no-proposal where the run proposed nothing; else under on the layer that set it; else under auto the trigger, in the order model-asked, cases, changes-existing, or, with none, the layer that set auto and ran false; a critic that would run but has no room left is not run, with budget. reasoning: the critic's tier, the host's criticReasoning, else the author's (criticReasoningFloor); absent where the run states no tier (an agent capability with no effort). trigger: under auto, the trigger that held, kept on a budget skip; absent otherwise. Emitted once per run as critic_decided and written in the checkpoint's critic.

policy.description: The report row: every resolved member with the host layer that supplied it. Carried through checkpoint resume.

continued.description: False on saved provider rows when a cross-family continuation is refused; their saved identities are retained.

id.description: 1–100 Unicode code points, including non-ASCII characters; not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units.

memories.description: Run report: proposals this run, and recalled ids and digests with kinds. Both lists survive resume; a recalled id supplied as revoked is reported revoked and withheld from the prompt.

edits.description: Ordered provenance of successful draft changes, including undo; the person and critic review the whole proposal.

outputGuard.description: ADR-0017: cumulative guarded match counts by stable pattern name; carried through resume.

recordFigures.description: Redactions in this record's storage pass, by stable pattern label; excludes delivered-output counts.
